catalogue.note: 2.0 full screen. Drawn in Figma at 0.75 of real size (270×600; instances carry scaleFactor 0.75): built at 360×800 with every value divided by 0.75: 24 margins, 40 button, 24 radius, 96-high amount input, type 24/18/14/13/12/11. Square-cornered: the frame’s 12px corners and its 1px #DDDDDD outline are left off, and the diff leaves that ring out. Status bar, bottom bar and icons are Figma’s export of the vectors. The bank logo is Figma’s export of the instance. The naira sign is not in Satoshi (the files on this Mac hold 431 glyphs, none of them U+20A6) and Figma draws it from a fallback face, the same outline at every weight: it is Figma’s own outline of the glyph, inline, 0.572em wide. The info symbol after the fee is SF Pro Display: Figma’s outline of it. Figma snaps each text baseline to a whole pixel at its own small scale, so some lines sit up to 1px lower in Figma than in a browser; they are left where the browser puts them. Edges that fall on fractions of a pixel are blurred over two rows by Figma and snapped to one by Chrome. Flat fills match exactly.
